description: A simple spreadsheet control for Avalonia, with an integrated formula engine and custom function support.
releaseNotes: v1.9.1: Fix the column / row geometry used by the cell renderer: the arrays of drawn column and row edges were filled starting from the width of the first drawn column (and height of the first drawn row) instead of from 0, so every cell was laid out one column / row further to the right / down than it should have been (the last drawn column and row were also dropped). xs[x] / ys[y] now hold the right / bottom edge of the x-th / y-th drawn column / row, with xs[0] = ys[0] = 0, which fixes the cell text, backgrounds, borders and the custom cell types (TitleCell, LinkCell, ButtonCell, TreeGradeCell, NumericCell) drifting away from their grid lines. Restyle the sheet tab strip after the classic Excel tab bar: the rail uses a neutral grey (SheetTabBackground still overrides it), the selected tab is white with a green bottom border and a bold caption, the other tabs are separated by the grid colour, and the tab context menu is localised (重命名 / 删除 / 向左移动 / 向右移动). v1.9.0: Add multiple worksheets: the spreadsheet now holds its content in SpreadsheetSheet objects (one per worksheet) and a native tab strip at the bottom (SheetTabStrip) lets the user switch between them. Worksheets can be added, inserted, removed, renamed and reordered from code (AddSheet / InsertSheet / RemoveSheet / RemoveSheetAt / RenameSheet / MoveSheet) and the control raises CurrentSheetChanged, SheetInserted, SheetRemoved, SheetRenamed and SheetMoved; the tab strip itself can be configured through SheetTabVisible, SheetTabVisibleWhenSingle, SheetTabNewButtonVisible, SheetTabAllowRename, SheetTabAllowDelete, SheetTabAllowInsert, SheetTabAllowReorder and SheetTabHiddenSheetsVisible, and styled through SheetTabHeight, SheetTabBackground, SheetTabForeground, SheetTabSelectedBackground and SheetTabBorderBrush. Every worksheet keeps its own data, formatting, geometry, merged ranges, hidden rows and columns, frozen panes, custom cells, scroll offset and formula engine (with the shared custom function registry), so switching worksheets restores everything exactly; the undo / redo stacks are cleared when the displayed worksheet changes. Properties and methods that existed before keep operating on the displayed worksheet, and most of them gained overloads that take an explicit SpreadsheetSheet (SetData, SetWidth, SetHeight, InsertColumns, DeleteColumns, ...). Add Excel .xlsx import (LoadXlsx(Stream) / LoadXlsx(string), XlsxImporter + XlsxImportOptions): one worksheet per workbook worksheet, in the same order, with the same name and visibility, so worksheet indices match the source file 1:1 (hidden worksheets included); formulas are kept and evaluated by the formula engine of their worksheet. Add multi-worksheet export (SaveXlsx(Stream, sheets, options) / SaveXlsx(string, sheets, options)): one Excel worksheet per worksheet, keeping names and visibility, so a workbook round-trips through LoadXlsx without losing the correspondence between worksheets and indices. Add per-worksheet options: IsReadOnly (blocks UI editing, pasting and clearing while the host can still write programmatically), AllowDragMoveCells, AllowTextOverflow (let a long text spill over empty neighbouring cells, off by default) and SelectionStyle (Fill or FocusRect, with matching header behaviour). Hidden worksheets can still be displayed from code through CurrentSheetIndex. v1.7.6: NumericLinkCell now shows a configurable placeholder for empty values (zero, blank or non-numeric) and stays clickable: ResponseEmpty defaults to true and the placeholder defaults to an ellipsis, resolved from LinkCell.EmptyText, then Table.EmptyNumericLinkText / Spreadsheet.EmptyNumericLinkText (set to null or empty to turn the placeholder off), then NumericLinkCell.DefaultEmptyText; the placeholder is drawn with EmptyBrush ?? LinkColor and follows the cell alignment. The clickable area is now governed by the new LinkCell.HitMode (LinkHitMode.TextOnly, the previous behaviour, EntireCellWhenEmpty, the default for NumericLinkCell, and EntireCell), and the same rectangle drives both the hand cursor on hover and the LinkClick event on release, so a cell that only shows the placeholder can be clicked anywhere inside it instead of on a 3 pixel wide glyph. Link cells no longer enter edit mode on double click, and link cells are rendered even when the cell has no data, so an empty cell still shows the placeholder (hit rectangles are cleared at the start of every frame, so a cell that has been scrolled out of view cannot swallow a click). The placeholder is display only: the xlsx export writes the underlying formatted value through the new LinkCell.GetExportText and copy / paste keep using the raw data. v1.7.5: Fix column / row resizing on sheets whose size is bounded by MaxTableWidth / MaxTableHeight (for example a page that sets the table to its own 8 columns and 13 rows): the drawing loops of GetRangeX / GetRangeY stop at that limit, so the last drawn line is the end of the table and there is no further column / row beyond it. HorizontalHeader.ResolveColumnHit and the new VerticalHeader.ResolveRowHit now clamp a position at or past that last line to the last drawn column / row, so grabbing the last border (from either side of it) resizes that column / row instead of resolving to the non-existent line -1, and clicking past the end of the table selects the last column / row; a running resize drag no longer stops as soon as the pointer moves past the end of the table while the button is still held, and the button state keeps deciding whether a move is a drag at all (so hovering never resizes). Dragging a border that sits next to a hidden column / row still resizes the previous *visible* one, in both directions. v1.7.4: Fix the rendering and the resizing of sheets with frozen panes. A merged range that crosses the frozen boundary is now laid out over the geometry of the whole merged range: every drawn region draws only the part that falls inside its own clip and the text stays one single continuous copy centred over the full range, instead of each region centring its own piece (which was wrong as soon as part of the range sits behind the frozen separator, and drifted further while column widths changed); also fixes an off-by-one that added the width of the column starting at xs[width] twice for ranges running past the visible area. Column / row resizing in HorizontalHeader / VerticalHeader no longer subtracts the scroll offset while the pointer is over a frozen strip (the frozen strips keep their own table coordinates, resolved through IsOverFrozenColumns / GetFrozenColumnIndex / GetColumnStart and their row counterparts) and no longer indexes the last drawn slice as if it always started at line 0, which together made the right-most column and the bottom-most row impossible to resize after FreezePanes. v1.7.3: Fix duplicate rendering of a merged range that crosses the frozen column / row boundary: the frozen strip region and the scrollable region each drew their own copy of the range, so a merged title spanning the frozen separator (e.g. row 1 merged over A:D with two frozen columns) was repeated on both sides of the separator and the two copies drifted apart while column widths were resized. Such a range is now drawn only by the region that contains its anchor side (RenderRegion takes the new frozenColumns / frozenRows flags); the other region leaves the rest of the merged area blank, like Excel does. v1.7.2: Numeric cells whose formatted value does not fit into the column are now truncated with a trailing ellipsis ("1,120,7…") instead of being clipped mid-glyph, matching the SSFinance WPF reference. This applies to NumericCell (drawn by the table renderer) and to NumericLinkCell (LinkCell gains a virtual UseEllipsisWhenClipped flag, enabled by NumericLinkCell; plain LinkCells keep the previous clipping behaviour). The longest fitting prefix is found by binary search with the shared TextTruncation helper, right alignment, negative red and strikethrough all follow the truncated width, and fully fitting values are untouched. v1.7.1: Add an icon mode to ButtonCell (ButtonCellMode.Icon), modelled after the RefCell cell body of the SSFinance WPF project: the cell keeps its normal text (editable unless SuppressEdit is set) and a small icon is drawn at the right edge of the cell, vertically centred, with the text area avoiding it; only the icon rectangle is clickable and raises Spreadsheet.CellTapped / CellDoubleTapped, while the rest of the cell behaves like a normal cell. The icon is highlighted on hover (light grey background, darker glyph), the default glyph is the RefCell magnifier and can be replaced through ButtonCell.IconPath (SVG path data); colours are customisable through IconFill / IconHoverFill / IconHoverBackground, and the icon size through IconSize (default 20). v1.7.0: Add a smooth expand / collapse animation for TreeGradeCell rows (Spreadsheet.IsTreeAnimationEnabled, Table.IsTreeAnimationEnabled / TreeAnimationDuration / TreeAnimationMaxRows): when a tree node is toggled, its child rows grow from zero height to their actual height and fade in (or shrink to zero and fade out) driven by a DispatcherTimer that interpolates the row heights at the single source Table.GetHeight, so rendering, headers, hit testing and keyboard navigation all follow the animation; collapsing rows are only added to HiddenRows after they have fully shrunk, the scroll offset is never touched so the viewport stays stable, a re-toggle while an animation is running snaps the previous one to its final state, and animations affecting more than 1000 rows are skipped automatically. v1.6.1: Add frozen rows and columns (Spreadsheet.FrozenRowCount / FrozenColumnCount, FreezePanes / FreezeRows / FreezeColumns / UnfreezePanes): the first n rows and / or columns stay in place at the top / left edge while the rest of the sheet scrolls, separated from the scrollable area by a thicker line; the frozen strips are drawn per quadrant with their own coordinate origin, are skipped by the scroll offset and the scroll-into-view logic, and hitting, selecting, editing, button / link / tree cells and the copy / cut / paste highlight overlay all resolve frozen coordinates correctly. v1.6.0: Add true column hiding (HiddenColumns, SetColumnVisible, SetColumnsVisible, ShowAllColumns, IsColumnHidden, IsColumnVisible, NextVisibleColumn and the Spreadsheet-level HideColumn / ShowColumn / HideRow / ShowRow convenience methods): a hidden column keeps its index but has a width of zero, so its data, header letter, header caption and grid lines disappear and the neighbouring columns are drawn seamlessly next to each other; hidden columns are skipped by rendering, hit testing, keyboard navigation, copy, paste, clear and fill, and are written as hidden Excel columns (XlsxExportOptions.ExportHiddenColumns, false by default). Fix a potential infinite loop in Table.GetRangeX / Table.GetCell when a column has zero width. Add ButtonCell, a clickable button (or underlined link) cell for values that are chosen from an external dialog instead of being typed (e.g. auxiliary accounting items): clicking it raises the new Spreadsheet.CellTapped / CellDoubleTapped events carrying the column, the row, the ButtonCell itself plus its CellType and Tag; while SuppressEdit is set (the default) double clicking, typing, F2 and Backspace do not open the editing box, and the chosen value is written back through Data which repaints the cell. v1.5.0: Add TreeGradeCell (account-tree cell with dotted guide lines and a +/- toggle box) together with the row-visibility infrastructure it needs (HiddenRows, SetRowVisible, ShowAllRows, IsRowVisible, NextVisibleRow, MoveVisibleRows): collapsed rows keep their index but occupy no vertical space and are skipped by rendering, hit testing, keyboard navigation, copy, paste, clear and fill. Clicking the toggle box raises the new Spreadsheet.TreeExpand event; with AutoManageRows (default true) the control also collapses / expands the rows below according to the node levels, otherwise the host does it through SetRowVisible. Add NumericCell (thousand separators, fixed decimals, zero as empty, optional red strikethrough / negative red) with commit-time validation: invalid input is rejected, the cell keeps its value, nothing is pushed onto the Undo stack and the new Spreadsheet.InvalidInput event is raised; NumericLinkCell now shares the same formatter. Add read-only ranges (SetRangeReadonly / IsCellReadonly / ReadonlyRanges) that block editing, pasting and clearing but still allow selecting and copying. Add the Spreadsheet.CellEditEnded event, raised after the data has been written (or after Escape / a rejected input) so hosts can recalculate dependent cells. Numeric cells are exported as real Excel numbers and collapsed rows are hidden in the exported sheet (XlsxExportOptions.ExportHiddenRows). v1.4.0: Export the spreadsheet to Excel .xlsx through the new SaveXlsx method (XlsxExporter + XlsxExportOptions): TitleCells become editable multi-line rich text runs; LinkCells become plain text (optionally with a real Excel hyperlink via ExportLinkAsHyperlink); formulas are kept when they are Excel-compatible (AVG is translated to AVERAGE) and replaced by their cached value otherwise; column widths, row heights, merged ranges, background fills, borders, fonts and text alignment are preserved. v1.3.0: Add LinkCell and NumericLinkCell, custom clickable hyperlink cells rendered instead of the regular text (three-state colours: link / pressed / visited, optional strikethrough, hit-testing cached during render); NumericLinkCell formats amounts with thousands separators and configurable decimals, renders zero values as empty (or "..." with ResponseEmpty); hovering shows a hand cursor, clicking (mouse press+release or Space while selected) raises the new Spreadsheet.LinkClick event carrying column, row and LinkPara; exposed through Table.LinkCells / RgfData.LinkCells / SpreadsheetControl.LinkCells, supported inside merged ranges. v1.2.0: Add TitleCell, a custom cell type for multi-chunk report captions (e.g. a title line followed by a subtitle line), exposed through Table.TitleCells / RgfData.TitleCells / SpreadsheetControl.TitleCells and rendered inside merged ranges; harden TitleCell font resolution so unresolvable font names or default (uninitialised) Typefaces fall back to the default font instead of throwing a NullReferenceException during layout. v1.1.3: Fix explicit border rendering off-by-one at the right/bottom edge of the viewport; clear cached formula results when loading RGF documents; refine ReoGrid v3 RGF parsing (v-border pos handling, style inheritance, font-size pt to DIP conversion, bold-only styles).
